_doc: Know your enemy (winning-build plan 2026-11-13, section 3.1; src/enemy_lore.py). 'probe': what the Wand of Probing reads: everything (it is a deliberate tool); and when the kind has a family and is not yet studied, the probe teaches it as a corpse study does (Brandon, 2026-11-14: KNOWN, and one more kind toward its family's tiers, Game._learn_kind), and 'learn' is said. {The}/{the} is the creature. 'quest_teach': a gate boss cannot be studied before the fight, so the key step of his quest opens his page, and the quest-giver names his weakness in her or his own voice; every line must stay true to the boss's lists in data/monsters.json: 'claims' names what the line says, and tests/test_know_your_enemy.py checks each claim against monsters.json. Recall Lore is not here: it gives a random hint from data/hints.json and never looks at a creature (Brandon, 2026-11-14).

probe.nothing: Nothing about {him} is weak or hard: every blow lands plain.

lines: Ariadne's voice comes again, more softly: "Take neither club nor hammer to him, for he was born of a bull, and it is a point between the ribs that will serve you."
asterion_minotaur.page: You know Asterion now: his page is open in your Bestiary.

lines: Athena speaks once more: "Perseus took her head with one stroke of a curved sword, for it is an edge that ends her. Poison will not serve, since her own blood is venom."
medusa_gorgon.page: You know Medusa now: her page is open in your Bestiary.

lines: The old voice speaks again: "Dig where he crawls down to drink, as Sigurd did, and strike upward with a point, for his scales turn both edge and hammer, both fire and venom. And remember that a worm lying on his gold is quick to fall asleep."
fafnir_dragon.page: You know Fafnir now: his page is open in your Bestiary.

lines: A gruff voice speaks from the dark behind the anvil: "Though he is bound, he is not beaten. He was whelped in the cold, and an edge slides off that coat, but he is a wolf, and fire bites every wolf."
fenrir_wolf.page: You know Fenrir now: his page is open in your Bestiary.

lines: The voice that weighed you speaks once more: "Fire, frost and venom are his own, and steel that cuts or crushes slides from him. What is holy wounds the Destroyer most of all."
abaddon_destroyer.page: You know Abaddon now: his page is open in your Bestiary.
